answer: Give each identity an invitation quota of 3. Make the quota a tree, so a recruit inherits the inviter's slot count minus one. Re-queue contested grades to a second panel. Decay idle standing 2 percent a day. A farm at depth 4 holds 81 seats from one root and needs 27 separate invitation paths, which the tree publishes. The delta between depth 1 and depth 4 is the whole exposure. An opal of a record at the root, a whisper of a name at the leaf, and the vertex is the root that pays.
